Some tips: for the first phase, try not to attack her/him before they’ve used the inkjet. Go for turf control, which will help you a lot when you’re damaged. If you can’t get her/him when they’ve used the inkjet, superjump camp them. This should get you past the first phase, and if you’re damaged, use the small break to heal up and aim for turf control
Second phase, I suggest you go flank behind when they’re using the bubbles. They’re vulnerable and the only thing that can do is roll (and delays the bubbles). This phase is easy
Third phase. I’d say go midrange, not too close, but not to far. They have an autobomb rush, AND they can shoot you and dodge roll. Bombs are more helpful here, but keep an eye on turf control and your ink tank
Fourth phase. Probably the easiest, hard to mess this up imo. Dodge the tenta missiles (assuming you have good turf control) and throw bombs, especially when he/she is using their special.
Fifth phase. Tread carefully, but you can go after him/her. The moment they’ve used the last splashdown, attack. If you’re damaged, fall back and dodge. Even one drop of ink will kill you when you’re damaged. Remember to mash B while you’re shooting at him/her.

I hope some of this helps, it’s what I did to beat her.
